valueNote: The coaching timeline across Punto de Break and El Espanol, with the ATP and RFET profile conflict flagged, is more useful than the usual top results. Most other facts are restated from ATP and RFET pages. The round-1 unsupported phrasings are fixed in this version.
summary: All round-1 rejection points are fixed: the Tokyo level now sits on an explicit RFET quote, 'pela primeira vez' is removed, 'por muitos anos' carries the El Espanol citation, the 'fontes divergem' framing is replaced by 'datam ... de formas diferentes', and the Lopez quotation is now a paraphrase. Every claim in the body, summary, knownFor, FAQ and person_json now checks against the opened sources. Two points rest on re-fetch wording that differed from round 1 and should be checked by a human editor on the live pages: the Tokyo 2026 'ATP 500' label (RFET re-fetch quotes 'ATP 500 de Tokio') and the Nitto hard/indoor records being career totals. Outdated check: the Vienna first-round match was not yet played as of 27 Oct 2026, and the No. 3 ranking and Race to Turin position are not contradicted by any later source found in web search.
